نبتذل (form VIII)
# نَبْتَذِلُ (nabtaḏilu) /nab.ta.ði.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# نُبْتَذَلُ (nubtaḏalu) /nub.ta.ða.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# نَبْتَذِلَ (nabtaḏila) /nab.ta.ði.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# نُبْتَذَلَ (nubtaḏala) /nub.ta.ða.la/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
